name: Bóveda del Río Almar (Spain)
description: Square white flag with two chequy squares of blue and white, two blue wavy bends sinister, two black arches and small green trees.
history: Municipal flag of Bóveda del Río Almar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two chequy panels at the upper fly and the lower hoist
two arches (vaults) at the upper hoist and the centre
small trees scattered on the field
